# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 11 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale volume hits 2026 high in July, but prices soften** - July recorded 2,660 HDB resale transactions — the highest monthly volume this year — while the resale price index continued to ease, now sitting 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

- **Bishan executive maisonette sells for S$1.65M, a new national record** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands on 4 August 2026 at S$1.65 million, making it both the priciest HDB resale flat in Bishan and the most expensive executive flat ever sold in Singapore. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

## En Bloc Reform: Proposed Lower Consent Thresholds

- **Parliament introduces Bill to cut en bloc consent thresholds for older condos** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner-consent requirement for collective sales from the current 80% to 70% for developments aged 40–59 years, and further to 65% for those aged 60 years and older. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-proposal-revive-en-bloc-hopes-for-older-condos/)

- **Lakeside Towers launches third en bloc attempt at $350 million** - The 45-year-old Lakeside Towers has relaunched its collective sale tender at an unchanged reserve price of $350 million, after previous attempts in 2018, 2022, and 2023 did not result in a sale. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-45-year-old-condo-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-350-million-price-tag/)

## Infrastructure: Cross Island Line Phase 3

- **CRL Phase 3 announced with four new stations extending west to Gul Circle** - Announced on 31 July 2026, Cross Island Line Phase 3 will add four stations and extend the line approximately 10km from the future Jurong Lake District station to Gul Circle. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/cross-island-line-phase-3/)
